title: Opening a website booking link confirms the booking, so mail scanners confirm bookings nobody made, and a link works on another Space's domain

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: app/hosted/[host]/confirm-booking/page.tsx:39 calls confirmGuestBookingAction(token) during the GET render. Outlook Safe Links and similar scanners open every emailed link, so a slot booked with someone else's address (what SCAN-834 stops) is confirmed automatically, with reminders and a CRM opt-in. outcome.spaceId is never compared with space.id, so Space B's token confirms under Space A's branding. THE FIX: render a Confirm button that posts a server action, and refuse when outcome.spaceId !== space.id.
